tut_intro: Short narrated videos, one for each page of the app: what every part shows, what it means and what to do with it.
tut_stream_note: Each video streams from GitHub only when you press play. Nothing is downloaded before that.
tut_subtitles_note: The narration is in English, with subtitles in every app language. Turn them on or switch them from the video's subtitles (CC) menu.
tut_error: The video couldn't be loaded from GitHub. Try again in a moment, or open it on GitHub.
tut_error_offline: You seem to be offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
tour_overview_desc: Your connection right now, the outage timeline, your router and what your data says.
tour_history_desc: Every outage and slowdown day by day, what caused it, and how to export it.
tour_notifications_desc: Every alert the app raised, where it was sent, and what was held back and why.
tour_speed_desc: Run a test, read the result and the lag under load, and compare today's tests.
tour_complaints_desc: One complaint from start to finish: log it, follow the deadline, send the evidence, escalate.
tour_report_desc: The whole month on one page, saved as a PDF or as a ZIP of evidence for your provider.
tour_settings_desc: Every setting explained: checks, alerts, notifications, speed test and the app itself.
